meta.title: Sample Cardiology Quiz
meta.description: A sample quiz for testing the engine

questions.question: What is the most common cause of heart failure?
questions.explanation: Coronary artery disease is the most common cause of heart failure, accounting for approximately 50-60% of cases.

questions.question: Which medication is first-line for stable angina?
questions.explanation: Beta-blockers are first-line for stable angina as they reduce myocardial oxygen demand.

questions.question: What is the normal PR interval on ECG?
questions.explanation: The normal PR interval is 0.12-0.20 seconds (3-5 small squares).
